The first pylon of the Field of Reeds, a tall gate crowned with blades. Its name begins "The mistress, terrible and great, the dominating wall."
A hawk-headed god keeps the first pylon, a knife in one hand and a blade raised in the other.
The deceased raises his hands before the first pylon. He knows its name and the name of its keeper, and is told: "Go through, thou art pure."
